display.purpose: Hero headlines only; compact overrides cascade from original-navigation.css.

body.purpose: All prose; Inter everywhere, 15px/1.65 in ink-soft.

shadows.name: shadow-soft
shadows.purpose: Light-ground standard cards and diagram figures.

shadows.name: primary-halo
shadows.purpose: Teal glow under the primary pill; deepens on hover.

shadows.name: glass-card
shadows.purpose: Orchestration glass card over the hero.

motion.name: ease-dock
motion.purpose: Docked index position and size morph.

components.name: Header Nav
components.description: Sticky blurred navy header; teal-violet underline marks current page.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:26px; background:rgba(7,24,39,.94); backdrop-filter:blur(18px); padding:0 24px; align-items:center; min-height:86px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11); font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color:#bbccd7; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; transition:color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:#fff; } .ds-nav .ds-current { color:#fff; position:relative; } .ds-nav .ds-current::after { content:""; position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:-10px; height:2px; border-radius:2px; background:linear-gradient(90deg,#13b99d,#7067f0); }

components.name: Primary Pill
components.description: Teal-gradient call to action with dark-green text and teal halo.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:52px; padding:0 22px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:999px; color:#05271f; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#62efd3,#a7f5e6); box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(28,210,177,.22); font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.94rem; font-weight:720; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 18px 42px rgba(28,210,177,.31); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(55,208,181,.7); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Outline Pill
components.description: Translucent white pill for secondary actions like the header GitHub link.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height:40px; padding:0 18px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25); border-radius:999px; color:#fff; background:rgba(255,255,255,.04); font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.82rem; font-weight:720; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.5); background:rgba(255,255,255,.09); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(55,208,181,.7); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Numbered Hero Card
components.description: Glass card with teal-violet top bar and numbered mini-flow list.
components.css: .ds-ocard { position:relative; padding:34px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13); border-radius:28px; background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(255,255,255,.095),rgba(255,255,255,.035)); box-shadow:0 28px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.22); backdrop-filter:blur(18px); font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; color:#eef7fb; } .ds-ocard::before { content:""; position:absolute; top:0; right:34px; left:34px; height:2px; background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#13b99d,#7067f0,transparent); } .ds-flow { margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none; display:grid; gap:14px; } .ds-flow li { display:grid; grid-template-columns:42px 1fr; gap:14px; } .ds-flow li>span { width:35px; height:35px; display:grid; place-items:center; border:1px solid rgba(116,222,202,.35); border-radius:10px; color:#8de8d7; background:rgba(55,208,181,.08); font-size:.68rem; font-weight:800; } .ds-flow strong { display:block; font-size:.92rem; } .ds-flow small { color:#8ca6b5; font-size:.75rem; }

components.name: Docked Index
components.description: Shrunk fixed index after hero scroll; teal marks current section.
components.css: .ds-dock { width:238px; padding:17px 18px 18px; border:1px solid rgba(176,219,229,.11); border-radius:28px; background:rgba(7,24,39,.08); box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(1,11,18,.08); backdrop-filter:blur(4px) saturate(110%); font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-dock ol { margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none; display:grid; gap:9px; } .ds-dock li { display:grid; grid-template-columns:43px 1fr; align-items:center; min-height:34px; } .ds-dock li>span { width:27px; height:27px; display:grid; place-items:center; border:1px solid rgba(116,222,202,.35); border-radius:9px; color:#8de8d7; background:rgba(55,208,181,.08); font-size:.62rem; font-weight:800; } .ds-dock a { color:#edf7fb; font-size:.82rem; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; transition:color 160ms ease; } .ds-dock a:hover, .ds-dock a.ds-on { color:#72ead8; } .ds-dock a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(114,234,216,.7); outline-offset:5px; border-radius:5px; }

narrative.overview: The interface reads as a working blueprint pinned up inside a lab: deep-navy canvas, a faint engineering grid, and soft teal and violet glows marking where energy concentrates. Pages open with a confident white headline, then spacious dark bands carry dense technical detail. The original stylesheets are imported byte-for-byte and hold highest precedence; Inter is the single font voice, depth comes from glow and glass blur rather than shadows on dark cards.
keyCharacteristics: Deep-navy blueprint canvas with faint grid and teal/violet radial glows
One font voice (Inter) with tight -0.035em tracking on headlines
Pill buttons; teal-gradient primary is the single loud accent
Numbered orchestration card doubles as a docked floating page index
Split section headings; 112–120px bands on alternating dark tones

rules.name: The Two-Glow Rule
rules.body: Every hero carries exactly two radial glows — violet top-right, teal bottom-left — at low opacity over the grid.

rules.name: The Teal Means State Rule
rules.body: Teal marks interactivity and current state; body copy is never teal, it stays ink or ink-soft.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Inter does all the work; Public Sans stays imported for legacy helpers but must not style new elements.

rules.name: The Flat Dark Surface Rule
rules.body: Cards on the navy foundation cast no shadows; elevation is glass blur, the primary halo, or light-section cards only.

dos: Do set heroes on var(--navy) with the grid layer plus exactly the teal and violet glows.
Do open every section with an uppercase teal section-label before the h2.
Do reuse legacy DOM classes (.shell, .nav-wrap, .hero-layout, .orchestration-card, .section-heading--split) instead of re-deriving layout.
Do give dark-ground interactive elements the 3px teal focus ring with 3px offset.
donts: Don't apply Public Sans (or any non-Inter face) to body or headline text.
Don't put drop shadows on cards sitting on the navy foundation; flat dark surfaces are the norm.
Don't introduce a second accent hue beyond the teal family and single violet counterpoint.
Don't write teal body copy; prose stays ink or ink-soft.
